description: This PHP source file defines the UpdateAttachmentController class responsible for handling HTTP requests to update attachments. It includes methods for processing uploaded files, updating attachment records, and logging actions, adhering to a REST API pattern.

classes.name: UpdateAttachmentController
classes.description: Controller class managing attachment update requests, including file handling and audit logging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller with necessary dependencies: attachment repository, file path service, and audit log service.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests to update attachments, processes uploaded files, and returns appropriate HTTP responses.

methods.name: updateAttachment
methods.description: Performs the actual update of an attachment file and metadata, saving the file and updating the database record.

methods.name: auditAction
methods.description: Logs the update action in the audit log for tracking purposes.
